blocks.text: “Cellophane” is a visual investigation into the boundaries of memory and identity, exploring how our minds fragment and preserve parts of our lives. Moving between dream and reality through subtle chiaroscuro, the series seeks an interpretation for a past that remains in the shadows, treating light and shadow as membranes between who we were and who we are now.
